visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white blazer enters a dimly lit hotel room decorated for a proposal. A man in a striped shirt stands waiting, holding a small cake and balloons. The room features a "MARRY ME" balloon banner, a path of LED floor lights, and heart-shaped balloon clusters on the bed. (2) The couple stands in the center of the room talking; the woman appears emotional and wipes her face while the man smiles and speaks to her. A large TV on the right wall reflects their movements. (3) The man hands over the cake and takes a bouquet of light-colored flowers. He delivers a long speech while the woman listens intently, alternating between smiling and dabbing her eyes. (4) The man kneels on one knee and presents a small black ring box. The woman reacts with a hand to her mouth in surprise, then leans in to look at the ring. (5) They embrace and kiss as the woman puts on the ring. Another woman briefly appears in the background holding a phone to record the moment. The couple poses for the camera together.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the sound of a woman entering a room and a man greeting her warmly. A soft, sentimental piano and acoustic guitar track plays at a low volume in the background. (2) The man speaks with a gentle, slightly nervous tone, while the woman's voice is high-pitched and trembling with emotion. Soft rustling of clothing and balloons is audible. (3) A third female voice is heard laughing softly in the background. The man begins a long narrative about their relationship; his speech rate is steady with emotional inflections. (4) As the man kneels, there is a momentary shift in the vocal focus, followed by the woman's clear, emotional '我願意' (I do). (5) The track concludes with the sound of several people cheering and laughing, while the music swells slightly before fading out as the conversation continues.
